title: Floral Harmony Portrait
description: Three women in profile face right, their heads merging into a large bouquet of flowers. The front woman has vibrant green skin and an elaborate red chrysanthemum headdress, the middle woman wears a yellow patterned headwrap, and the rear woman has purple skin with intricate spiral patterns. The background is a dark, swirling cosmic space filled with glowing orbs and bokeh lights.
prompt: Three women shown in profile facing right with their heads blending into one another, the foremost with green skin and a massive red chrysanthemum for hair, the middle with a yellow patterned headwrap, and the third with purple skin and spiral facial patterns. A large bouquet of bright orange and yellow tulips emerges from their heads. They are set against a dark swirling cosmic background filled with glowing golden orbs and soft bokeh lights, vibrant surreal style with rich colors and intricate details.
